scientific_question: Does replacing raw pair-depth coefficients with geometry-local Riesz action coordinates make the fixed K4-K1 dual correction predictably transferable across complete PoolFire trajectories before any larger model is considered?
reason_for_new_gate: v142.4.1 independently showed that the fixed teacher has 3700/3700 mechanism capacity but the deployment-visible shared linear map to raw coefficients passes only 1/3700 cells and 0/5 trajectories. Raw coefficients mix the physical correction with a sample-specific non-orthogonal basis inverse. v143 tests that mechanism directly without changing the teacher, folds, visible inputs, exact-call shell, or model capacity.

coordinate.label: geometry_local_block_riesz_action
coordinate.groups: one block per active target camera and detector component
coordinate.label_gauge: global unit RMS across active directions
coordinate.deployment_inverse: c_g = (B_g B_g^T + 1e-6 mean(diag(B_g B_g^T)) I)^-1 a_hat_g
coordinate.camera_permutation_rule: groups and direction outputs co-permute with active cameras

predictor.model: same 155-parameter shared linear direction ridge as v142.4
predictor.inputs: same deployment-visible target, peer, pooled-camera, direction-observable and token features as v142.4
predictor.target: Riesz action coordinate rather than raw coefficient
predictor.nested_selection: leave one of the four outer-fit trajectories out

sentinel.strata: one cell for each of 5 trajectories x 4 camera counts
sentinel.selector: minimum SHA256 of oerf-v143-riesz-action-sentinel-v1|trajectory|camera_count|sample_index within each stratum

decision_rule.all_20_pass: Authorize a separately frozen full 3700-cell physical replay of this coordinate. Do not authorize a neural model, resource gate, external gate, or paper claim.
decision_rule.any_oracle_inverse_failure: Close the regularized Riesz inverse as numerically unsuitable under this basis.
decision_rule.any_prediction_or_trajectory_tail_failur: Close the shared-linear Riesz-action hypothesis. Do not retune thresholds, choose another target after seeing results, or rescue it with a larger model.
decision_rule.execution_or_independent_recomputation_f: Inconclusive; preserve evidence and do not interpret partial arrays.
